item.title: Fine Gael conference hears from people with disabilities on accessibility and inclusion
item.description: Fine Gael turned the focus on people with disabilities, advocates and carers when the party held its first Disability Network Conference in Galway on Saturday – discussing the issues facing people with disabilities in Ireland and to outline their experiences. item.title: Kiltevna native sees her Norwegian-born son set Olympic record on the slopes
item.description: The son of a Galway mother – making history this week as just the second man to ever compete in three Olympic Winter Games – got his three-pronged target off to a great start on Sunday. item.title: Driver hit 206km/h before dumping his car in farmyard
item.description: An apprentice electrician caught travelling at lightning speed on the motorway near Ballinasloe abandoned his car in a farmyard after a high-speed Garda chase. Joseph Kelly was detected driving his 131 silver Vauxhall at a speed of 206km/h in a 120km/h zone on the M6 Motorway at Cloonamergaun, Aughrim, Ballinasloe. item.description: A local TD has claimed that the state’s new rental rules could see local tenants facing an annual increase of over €4,000 – or 25 per cent. item.title: Taoiseach opens two new significant developments in Ballinasloe
item.description: Ballinasloe’s social housing stock received a major boost at the weekend as Taoiseach Micheál Martin officially opened two Galway County Council housing developments, marking the delivery of 74 new homes in the East Galway town.
